title: Implement Podio App Fetching
description: Create function to fetch app definition from Podio API. Must use authenticated access token, call /app/{app_id} endpoint, parse response correctly, handle app not found errors, and handle permission errors.
details: Sprint 3 - App Fetching + TS Config Generation. Fetches app metadata from Podio.
testStrategy: Test with valid app ID, invalid app ID, no permissions, verify response parsing.
